ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low macro-level ratio (~10-15%) of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as localized focal points across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of small, circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white blobs (rosettes) mapped across the dark 2D surface of both lobes, lacking large-scale contiguous geometric white banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated acute angle and significant bounding-box depth dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) forming a jagged, serrated continuous linear boundary along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve trajectory observed from the median notch to the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme spatial density of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings on dark background) corresponding to barnacle colonization sites across the entire visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle detection of short, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) on the right lobe, partially obscured by the high-density rosette scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring from barnacle attachment sites covering approximately 80% of the visible ventral fluke surface.
